title: JWT Token Payload Schema
description: Schema for JWT access token payload used in authentication system

sub.description: Subject: Unique user identifier (primary key from users table). Used by backend to filter database queries and enforce user isolation.

email.description: User's email address. Included for convenience and debugging. NOT used for authorization (use 'sub' instead).

iat.description: Issued At: Unix timestamp (seconds since epoch) when token was created. Standard JWT claim.

exp.description: Expiration: Unix timestamp (seconds since epoch) when token expires. Set to iat + 3600 (1 hour). Standard JWT claim.

type.description: Token type identifier. Always 'access' for access tokens. Distinguishes from potential future refresh tokens.

notes.secret: Stored in JWT_SECRET environment variable (must be identical in frontend and backend)

usage.frontend: Stored in localStorage, attached to API requests via Authorization header
usage.backend: Verified on every protected endpoint, user ID extracted from 'sub' claim

security.signature_verification: Backend MUST verify signature using shared secret before trusting payload
security.expiration_check: Backend MUST reject expired tokens (exp < current time)
security.user_existence: Backend SHOULD verify user ID exists in database (optional but recommended)
